observed_summary.interpretation: Repeated oid values represent multiple catalogued flare events per ZTF object in this event catalogue; they must not be automatically deduplicated as duplicate light-curve rows.

validation_limits: This is an event catalogue, not a per-observation light-curve table; it must not be passed to the light-curve normalizer as if each row were an observation.
This bounded audit was computed from the public CSV content fetched via the GitHub connector; no local copy, SHA-256, model inference, or scientific performance evaluation is claimed.
Catalog labels and physical parameters retain the source publication's definitions and selection effects.
next_actions: Add a reproducible local audit command that emits these counts and SHA-256 from a downloaded source file.
Use the catalogue to define a source-specific flare-event analysis workflow, separate from general light-curve ingestion.
Retrieve a small real TESS Transients text file and TGLC FITS file and verify their adapters against raw-file hashes and source row counts.
